ticket.summary: Upstairs toilet runs continuously into bowl for several days; ~12-year-old fixture, no overflow or water damage — flat-rate tank rebuild booked Sep 1 at 3:00 PM.

quote_lines.description: Running toilet rebuild (fill + flush valve), parts and labor

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Nora! Tomorrow (Mon Sep 1) at 3:00 PM, 402 Ashgrove Ter — running toilet rebuild, $189 flat rate covering parts and labor, about an hour on site. Only possible add-on is the $139 shutoff valve replacement if that valve is corroded, and the tech will ask first. In the meantime, if the trickle gets worse you can close the oval shutoff valve on the supply line under the toilet (clockwise until snug) [PB-01]. Thanks for texting us after hours!
